non_case_law_excluded: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov (statutes — used for Pen. Code § 3008 verbatim)
OAL / CDCR rulemaking pages (regulations — OAL Matter 2025-0321-01C pinned 15 CCR § 3574 effective date)
CDCR Form 3043 (agency form, not publicly openable as standalone)
scope: Case-law citation verification sources isolated from the Matter 28 primary-source verification prompt (2026-09-19). Rule 2 of the prompt gives the preference order; 'proven_in_run' marks sources a verification worker actually read successfully during the 2026-09-19 run.

sources.coverage: Federal + state opinions; citation-lookup and full-text search APIs
sources.name: CourtListener
sources.provenance: Opinions search used for Wicklund v. Idaho (zero results — confirmed unreported)
sources.wire_notes: Already probed by lookup-citations.py (citation lookup + search). No change needed.

sources.coverage: Reporter PDFs for published state/federal cases (citation-addressable)
sources.name: Caselaw Access Project (static.case.law)
sources.provenance: Pollock 112 Cal.App.4th 1416 and Sain v. Wood 512 F.3d 886 read from reporter PDFs
sources.wire_notes: Already probed by lookup-citations.py (lookup_cap). No change needed.

sources.coverage: Federal/state opinions (HTML) + federal docket PDFs via docs.justia.com
sources.name: Justia (law.justia.com + docs.justia.com)
sources.provenance: Wicklund memo, Valvo 67 Cal.App.3d 887 read in full; Merrill S.D. Cal. orders via docs.justia.com
sources.wire_notes: Already probed by lookup-citations.py (probe_justia). No change needed.

sources.name: Google Scholar
sources.wire_notes: Already probed by lookup-citations.py (probe_scholar). No change needed.

sources.coverage: Federal opinions incl. USCOURTS collection; official API with key
sources.name: govinfo.gov (GPO)
sources.wire_notes: Most API-friendly unwired source: api.govinfo.gov (needs key) + bulk data. Recommended first new probe.

sources.name: Ninth Circuit opinions (cdn.ca9.uscourts.gov)
sources.wire_notes: URL pattern .../opinions/YYYY/MM/DD/<docket>.pdf. Docket-number-addressable, no citation resolver. Covers the portfolio's heaviest circuit (Palomar, Lee, ASARCO, Rawson, Kirtley, Caviness, Heath, Schreiber, DZ Reserve, Arizona Students' Ass'n, Esche). Recommended second new probe.

sources.coverage: Cal. Supreme Court + Courts of Appeal opinions (PDF)
sources.name: California Courts opinions (courts.ca.gov)
sources.provenance: Meinhardt (2024) 16 Cal.5th 643 read in full from .../opinions/documents/S274147.PDF
sources.wire_notes: URL pattern .../documents/<DOCKET>.PDF (e.g. S274147.PDF). Docket-addressable; needs docket-number lookup step.

sources.coverage: Slip opinions + bound-volume PDFs; authoritative for unbound U.S. Reports cites
sources.name: U.S. Supreme Court (supremecourt.gov)
sources.wire_notes: No public API. Highest marginal value: unbound cites like Horn 604 U.S. ___ (no reporter page exists yet) — slip opinions are the only authoritative source.

sources.name: Cornell LII — Supreme Court
sources.wire_notes: URL pattern /supremecourt/text/<volume>/<page> (e.g. /521/399 for Richardson). Citation-addressable with no lookup step — cheapest SCOTUS probe to add.

sources.coverage: Cal. Supreme Court opinions, full HTML text
sources.name: SCOTUSblog-style: scocal.stanford.edu (Cal. Supreme Court)
sources.wire_notes: Slug-addressable HTML (e.g. /opinion/goddard-v-security-title-ins-guar-co-25274). Needs cite-to-slug resolution; useful fallback when CAP lags.

sources.name: FindLaw Caselaw
sources.wire_notes: No API; HTML scraping only. Lowest priority — duplicates CAP/CourtListener coverage.

sources.name: alldocket.com
sources.provenance: Estate of Esche (9th Cir. Sept. 29, 2025) read in full from .../estate-of-jill-ann-esche-v-bunuel-jordana-10679498-1e95b21f039a/pdf
sources.wire_notes: Opaque IDs (.../<slug>/<id>/pdf); not systematically addressable. Manual fallback only — do not build a probe around it.

wiring_recommendation.note: The four already-wired sources (CourtListener, CAP, Justia, Scholar) cover nearly all published cases. New probes add marginal value in three spots only.
priority_order: govinfo (official API — most robust new probe)
supremecourt_gov slip opinions (only authoritative source for unbound U.S. cites, e.g. Horn 604 U.S. ___)
courts_ca_gov + scocal (Cal. direct PDFs as fallback)
